paras.text: Before the match starts the administration will appoint four umpires. These umpires will perform their duties impartially. Of these umpires, two will be match umpires, one third umpire, and the fourth will be a substitute umpire. The match umpires can take the opinion of the third umpire to reach some correct result. The third umpire cannot give an opinion on the decisions given by the other umpires of his own will.

Scorer

The scorer too is appointed before the match starts. He will work according to the instructions and signals of the umpires and will also give them a return signal.

Ball

The ball is made of leather. Its colour is red. In day-night competitions a white ball is also used.

Weight of the ball: 156 to 163 grams

Circumference of the ball: 22.4 to 22.9 centimetres

The captain of the fielding team can ask for a new ball after the fixed overs have been bowled.
